glossary.definition: (D) As used in this section, "profits" means the revenue from the sale of commissary items over and above operating costs and a reserve established by the managing officer of the institution.
glossary.source_title: Section 5139.86 - Cafeteria fund - industrial and entertainment fund - youth benefit fund - employee food service fund.
